body: Anthropic's open GitHub marketplace (anthropics/financial-services, also referenced as financial-services-plugins) ships vertical plugins (financial-analysis core, equity-research, investment-banking, private-equity, etc.), ~10 agent plugins, slash-command skills (/dcf, /comps, /earnings, /initiate, /screen, /thesis, /catalysts) and MCP connectors to institutional data (FactSet, S&P/Kensho, Morningstar, LSEG, Daloopa, Aiera, PitchBook, Moody's, MT Newswires). Retail-accessible data comes via community/official MCP servers (Financial Datasets, Alpha Vantage, Yahoo Finance, Polygon/Massive, Alpaca) and in India via Zerodha's official Kite MCP and a Trendlyne connector.
